title: Public-company trading-comparables valuation
prompt:
Calculate the public-company trading-comparables valuation for the acquisition target labeled `Target` in the current July 3 Investor Relations peer-analysis workstream.

Use the July corporate-development investment-committee correspondence for transaction context and the controller's banker-case warning. For this valuation, use the current controller-tied peer-support workbook, dated peer-market export, comparability decisions, and approved methodology in `Shared/Finance/Investor Relations/Peer analysis/`. Keep the June 27 banker pull only for comparison. This request is for the public-company peer-analysis workstream, not the separate Pioneer HVAC active-deal IC model. Do not use Alder Ridge's posted ledger balances.

Show the inclusion decision for each peer from Peer A through Peer G. For the peer excluded because of the documented noncomparable transaction, also report its EBITDA and revenue multiples. Calculate the median and the inclusive 25th and 75th percentiles for both EV/LTM adjusted EBITDA and EV/LTM revenue.

Build lower, base, and upper valuation conclusions. Apply the lower-quartile, median, and upper-quartile multiple pairs to `Target`'s standalone metrics, reconcile each pair using the approved weighting, and bridge each enterprise-value conclusion to equity value using the same approved net-debt treatment. Reconcile the width of the resulting equity-value range. Do not use the acquisition target's proposed synergies.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `peer_a_included`, `peer_b_included`, `peer_c_included`, `peer_d_included`, `peer_e_included`, `peer_f_included`, `peer_g_included`, `excluded_peer_ev_ebitda`, `excluded_peer_ev_revenue`, `lower_quartile_ev_ebitda`, `median_ev_ebitda`, `upper_quartile_ev_ebitda`, `lower_quartile_ev_revenue`, `median_ev_revenue`, `upper_quartile_ev_revenue`, `lower_quartile_ebitda_implied_enterprise_value`, `ebitda_implied_enterprise_value`, `upper_quartile_ebitda_implied_enterprise_value`, `lower_quartile_revenue_implied_enterprise_value`, `revenue_implied_enterprise_value`, `upper_quartile_revenue_implied_enterprise_value`, `lower_quartile_weighted_enterprise_value`, `weighted_enterprise_value`, `upper_quartile_weighted_enterprise_value`, `lower_quartile_implied_equity_value`, `implied_equity_value`, `upper_quartile_implied_equity_value`, `implied_equity_value_range_width`. Use dollars to two decimals and multiples to at least four decimals.
